_published_faq.name: How do I add ICD-10 Codes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ICD-10 Codes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://hcls.mcp.claude.com/icd10_codes/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is ICD-10 Codes MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, ICD-10 Codes scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ICD-10 Codes MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ICD-10 Codes provides these MCP tools: get_hierarchy, get_by_category, get_by_body_system, lookup_code, search_diagnosis_by_code, search_diagnosis_by_description, search_procedure_by_code, search_procedure_by_description, and validate_code.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ICD-10 Codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ICD-10 Codes in health on the Manufact MCP catalog include CMS Coverage, NPI Registry, AllTrails MCP Server, PopHIVE, and Alma.

_published_faq.name: Does ICD-10 Codes MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: ICD-10 Codes does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
ICD-10 Codes is developed by Anthropic. It is listed as anthropic on the Claude connector directory.
